_about: Synthetic issues for the private GitLab group. Created in this order, so each project's issue numbers (iid) match the references in slack.json (engineering#1 is the first engineering issue). 'author' and comment authors are handles from people.json, recorded in a hidden note because everything is posted by one account. 'created_at' is set through the API (allowed for project owners).

issues.title: QA stage times out on the staging deploy pipeline
issues.author: arjun.mehta
issues.description:
The QA job in the staging deploy pipeline times out after 30 minutes. Started after the runner pool change last week.

**Stopgap:** timeout raised to 45 minutes.
**Fix:** split the QA job into parallel jobs so each finishes well under the limit.

comments.author: daniel.kim
comments.body: Runner pool for the QA stage was scaled down by mistake. Scaled back to 12 runners.

comments.author: arjun.mehta
comments.body: QA job split into 4 parallel jobs. Longest one now takes 11 minutes. Closing.

issues.title: Document the release checklist for new release managers
issues.author: rachel.cohen
issues.description: New release managers keep asking the same questions. Write down the steps we follow for the monthly release, linking to the handbook page on release managers: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/releases/release-managers/

comments.author: arjun.mehta
comments.body: Checklist added to the engineering wiki page 'Release runbook'.

issues.title: Flaky test: merge request widget spec fails intermittently
issues.author: aiko.tanaka
issues.description: The MR widget spec fails roughly 1 in 20 runs on CI with a timing error. Quarantined for now; needs a proper wait instead of a fixed sleep.

issues.title: Add index on merge request diffs to speed up the MR page
issues.author: meera.iyer
issues.description: The MR page query on merge request diffs takes ~900 ms at p95. A partial index on the active diffs should bring it under 200 ms. Migration runs in the Thursday maintenance window.

comments.author: sofia.rossi
comments.body: Migration done. p95 is now ~120 ms. Closing.

issues.title: New diff file tree in code review (feature flag rollout)
issues.author: tomas.rivera
issues.description: The new file tree in the diff view is behind the `diff_file_tree_v2` feature flag. Rollout plan: internal users this week, 10% next week, then 100% if no regressions.

comments.author: oluwaseun.adeyemi
comments.body: Looks great. Please add the rollout steps to the issue before going to 10%.

issues.title: CI job token exposed in a public fork's job log
issues.author: nadia.haddad
issues.description:
A CI job token appeared in plain text in a public fork's job log. Token revoked at 07:50 UTC.

Timeline, impact and follow-ups below.

comments.author: victor.petrov
comments.body: Audit logs show no use of the token before revocation. Root cause: a debug flag printed CI variables. Fix in review.

comments.author: nadia.haddad
comments.body: Fix merged and the debug flag removed. Closing the incident.

issues.title: Phishing campaign using fake Workday emails
issues.author: nadia.haddad
issues.description: Several team members received emails imitating Workday asking them to 'confirm their PTO balance'. Sender domains blocked. Collecting reports via /security.
